intro.zh: 今天这批项目共同指向一件事：AI 正在从「会聊天」转向「能干活」，而围绕它的配套正在快速分层——有人做更轻的浏览器底座，有人做可审计的桌面同事，有人把工程经验固化成可复用的技能包。创业机会不在再做一个模型，而在这些层之间的缝隙里。
intro.en: Today's projects share one signal: AI is shifting from chat to actual work, and the stack around it is splitting into layers. Lightweight browser infrastructure, auditable desktop coworkers, and reusable skill packs are all emerging at once.

zh.summary: 开源的 AI 同事框架，每个代理分到独立浏览器、文件和授权工具，动作执行前先决策、执行后留记录。可接入任意 AG-UI 代理，跑在自己的基础设施上，形态对标 ChatGPT 但完全可改。
zh.insight: 企业最怕代理乱点按钮。它的「先决策后记录」正好切合规敏感行业，比如财务对账、客服工单处理，卖点不是能力而是可审计。

en.summary: An open-source framework for AI coworkers where each agent gets its own browser, files, and granted tools. Every action is decided before it runs and logged after.
en.insight: Enterprises fear agents clicking the wrong thing. The decide-then-log model fits compliance-heavy work like reconciliation or ticket handling,

items.description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.

zh.summary: 本地优先的多代理桌面应用，由一个指挥官把目标拆成待办，调度十六个内置专家代理，并接入 Claude Code、Codex 等已有编码代理。项目保存目标、规则、记忆和文件，跨会话延续上下文。
zh.insight: 它把「项目」而非「对话」作为单位，适合做长周期交付场景，比如独立开发者接单或小团队外包。可以围绕某个垂直行业预置代理团队和流程模板。

en.summary: A local-first multi-agent desktop app. A commander breaks goals into todos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents plus existing coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.
en.insight: Treating the project rather than the chat as the unit suits long-running delivery work. A vertical package with preconfigured agent teams and workflow…

items.description: Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first AI team for your desktop: a Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, with projects, scheduled automations and connectors. Free app for macOS & Windows; built-in models or your own keys.

zh.summary: Notebook LM 的开源替代，强调隐私、多模型和完全本地运行。用户可以把自己的资料变成可对话的知识库，不必上传到 Google，功能上还做了扩展。
zh.insight: 适合切教育、律所、医疗等不能外传资料的场景。与其做通用笔记，不如做「某类文档的本地问答」，比如合同、病历或课程材料。

en.summary: An open-source, privacy-focused alternative to Google's Notebook LM. It runs fully local, supports multiple models,
en.insight: It fits education, law, and healthcare, where documents cannot leave the building. A local Q&A tool for one document type,

items.description: An Open Source implementation of Notebook LM with more flexibility and features

zh.summary: 用 Zig 从零写的无头浏览器，专为 AI 代理和自动化设计，不是 Chromium 分支。内存占用约为 Chrome 的十六分之一，执行速度快约九倍，支持 CDP 协议，可直接接 Playwright 和 Puppeteer。
zh.insight: 代理爬取和自动化测试的成本大头是浏览器实例。可以围绕它做按需渲染的抓取服务，或给现有 RPA 产品做降本替换，接口兼容意味着迁移成本低。

en.summary: A headless browser written from scratch in Zig for AI agents and automation, not a Chromium fork. It uses roughly 16x less memory and runs about 9x faster than Chrome,
en.insight: Browser instances dominate the cost of agent scraping and test automation. A metered rendering service or a drop-in cost cut for existing RPA products is…

items.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 英伟达 Nemotron 系列的开发者资源中心，汇集训练配方、使用手册、数据集和端到端示例。新模型面向多模态代理推理和长时运行代理的执行层，权重和配方一并开放。
zh.insight: 开放训练配方意味着可以基于它做行业微调服务，而不是从零训练。适合切有私有数据但缺算力调优能力的垂直行业，交付的是配方适配而非模型。

en.summary: NVIDIA's developer hub for the Nemotron family, bundling training recipes, cookbooks, datasets, and end-to-end examples.
en.insight: Open recipes make domain fine-tuning services viable without training from scratch. Target verticals with private data but no tuning capacity,

items.description: Developer Asset Hub for NVIDIA Nemotron — A one-stop resource for training recipes, usage cookbooks, datasets, and full end-to-end reference examples to build with Nemotron models
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 轻量的元提示与上下文工程框架，用分阶段循环驱动 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等多种编码代理，强调规范驱动开发。与重型流程框架相比，它更接近一层薄协议。
zh.insight: 多代理工具并存是现实，跨工具的流程层有需求。可以做团队级的规范与上下文管理，解决换模型或换编辑器后流程重搭的问题。

en.summary: A lightweight meta-prompting and context-engineering framework that drives coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor through a disciplined phase loop.
en.insight: Teams already run several agent tools at once, so a cross-tool process layer has demand. Team-level spec and context management solves the rebuild-everything…

zh.summary: 纯 Rust 从零写的页面与版式设计编辑器，定位现代桌面出版，原生跑在三大平台，也能通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器里用。自带段落排版引擎，能处理多栏正文和绕排引文。
zh.insight: 桌面出版长期被 Adobe 和 Affinity 把持，开源几乎空白。可以先切细分印刷场景，比如期刊、简历或学术海报，用模板加排版质量做差异。

en.summary: A page and layout design editor written from scratch in pure Rust, positioned as modern desktop publishing. It runs natively on three platforms and in the browser via WebAssembly,
en.insight: Desktop publishing has long been locked up by Adobe and Affinity with little open source. A narrow print niche such as journals, resumes, or academic posters,

items.description: DesignCraft: An open-source page and layout design editor written by scratch in pure Rust

zh.summary: 一位资深工程师公开的日常代理技能目录，强调小而可组合、适配任意模型，反对接管流程的重型框架。它代表了一种态度：技能应该是工程师自己改的东西，而不是被规范绑架。
zh.insight: 技能包本身难变现，但「技能市场加版本管理」有空间。可以切团队协作场景，解决多人共用代理时提示词散落、无法评审和回滚的问题。

en.summary: A senior engineer's public directory of everyday agent skills, deliberately small, composable, and model-agnostic.
en.insight: The skills themselves are hard to monetize, but a marketplace with version control has room. Target team collaboration,

items.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.

zh.summary: Anthropic 官方的代理技能实现，技能是包含指令、脚本和资源的文件夹，由模型按需动态加载，用于把品牌规范、数据流程等重复任务标准化。也是技能标准的事实参考实现。
zh.insight: 这是基础设施和趋势信号。真正的机会在标准之上的工具链：技能打包、权限声明、依赖检查，以及企业内部技能仓库的治理。

en.summary: Anthropic's official implementation of agent skills: folders of instructions, scripts, and resources loaded on demand to make recurring tasks repeatable,
en.insight: This is infrastructure and a trend signal. The opportunity sits above the standard: packaging, permission declarations, dependency checks,

zh.summary: 开源的兼容层，让玩家把自己合法购买的 Switch 版暗黑破坏神 II 重生跑在 iPhone、iPad、Mac、安卓和鸿蒙上，重做了触屏操作，保持六十帧，并支持原生 macOS。
zh.insight: 这是趋势信号：兼容层加自带游戏文件正在成为一类灰色但活跃的工程方向。可借鉴的是触屏重映射与性能适配层，而非游戏本身。

en.summary: An open-source compatibility layer that runs your own legally purchased Switch copy of Diablo II Resurrected on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, and HarmonyOS,
en.insight: A trend signal: compatibility layers with bring-your-own-files are becoming a lively if gray engineering niche.

items.description: Open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS / 安卓 / 鸿蒙兼容层
